description: Reads the creator minimum deposited for a block’s market (who deposited, how much, whether the 0.03% creator share is flowing) and, when `account` is that creator, returns the unsigned call for the next exit step: a request (the share stops at once), then, 7 days later, the withdrawal.

account.description: Optional: the wallet that would sign the exit.

pair.description: The currency it was paired with at birth: ETH (default) or an address.

name: tblock_creator_minimum
title: Read or exit the creator minimum of a block
